implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA: there was no canonical scoring definition — packages/shared-types/src/playerRank.ts hard-coded the window/weights/thresholds/rounding with no version id, no abstention rules for shotType/source/capturedAt/duplicate ids, no golden fixtures, and no way to check Edge or SQL against identical inputs (the r1 adversary showed SQL ranking a shotType:'' row the TS definition abstains on, and the __wf__ import map could not even load shared-types without --sloppy-imports). Fix: (1) new packages/shared-types/src/scoringDefinition.ts — deep-frozen SCORING_DEFINITION with SCORING_DEFINITION_VERSION='rank-form-weighted-v2' and exactly nine ordered components (countability, scoreQuantization, recencyOrder, formWindow, recencyWeights, techniqueScore, confidenceWeight, rating, tiers), each countability rule annotated with the server layer/check that enforces it (Edge parseSyncShot for shotType; SQL constraints for resultKind/overallScore/source/capturedAt/pkey), plus golden fixture types and PLAYER_RANK_GOLDEN_SCHEMA_VERSION; (2) playerRank.ts now derives every constant from SCORING_DEFINITION, enforces the countability rules (finite 0–10 score, trimmed non-empty ≤64-char shotType, source real/absent, capturedAt within [2000,2100), duplicate ids counted once, uppercase-UUID tie-break), quantizes on decimal text to match numeric(4,2), and stamps definitionVersion on every summary — this is the shipping path used by apps/mobile/src/progress/playerRank.ts rankFromFacts; (3) fixtures/scoring/player-rank.golden.json — 21 valid cases + 12 rejected inputs, each rejected input naming the exact Edge check or SQL constraint that refuses it; (4) test-first regression scoringDefinition.golden.test.ts (fails on BASE: module absent; 34 pass on HEAD); (5) supabase/functions/api/__wf__/w06_01_golden_parity.test.ts proves TS ↔ Edge sync ingress ↔ SQL player_rank_state ↔ GET /v1/rank agree on every golden case against Postgres 16 with all migrations (11/11), and the r1 adversary harness now passes (5/5); (6) additive __wf__/deno.json import-map aliases so the harness loads without --sloppy-imports. The r1 break is resolved by making the definition's abstention rules mirror what the server planes actually enforce and by proving, in the fixture, that every abstaining row is refused by ingress (never stored) rather than pretending SQL evaluates rows it can never hold.
